summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title(title) classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple to the constructor. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor; it gates only on is_terminal, writes the control, and returns True, or returns False when not a terminal. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that reads the title from the second item and calls term.set_title(title) once. CHANGELOG.md gains an Added heading above Fixed under Unreleased with a bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (returns early on legacy consoles), test_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only via the existing skip marker). Not verified: tests were not run, mypy and black were not run, so the union type-check and formatting are checked by reading only.
